title: cngx error-code manifest
description: Every coded diagnostic the cngx libs emit through cngxDevWarn / cngxDevError or throw as a CngxRuntimeError, generated by scripts/error-codes-manifest.mjs from the call sites and the pages under core-concepts/error-codes/. Bump schemaVersion here and in the generator on any shape change.

docsBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the code pages; a page is <docsBaseUrl>cngx<nnnn>.html.

lib.description: The lib that emits codes in this range.
The lib whose range holds the code.

severity.description: The channel: a console helper (warn, error) or a thrown CngxRuntimeError (throw); null for a retired code.

production.description: stripped: a production build drops the code (console diagnostics, dev-only throws). code-only: the error is thrown in production with the bare code as its message. null for a retired code.

page.description: Repo-relative path of the doc page.

files.description: Repo-relative source files that emit the code; empty when retired.
